_source: MIXED - identity is REAL, the score is partly simulated
_realFields: id, name, category, city, gst, iec exist in the sandbox via API_BUSINESS_PARTNER (A_Supplier) plus A_BusinessPartnerAddress and A_BusinessPartnerTaxNumber.
_simulatedFields: sapScore stands for SAP's own vendor evaluation (transaction ME61 / table ELBK). The sandbox exposes no evaluation data, so this is invented. contractRate is the agreed price for the supplier's main contract item.

suppliers._note: Deliberately has NO entry in supplier-history.json. Every real system has vendors you hold a master record for but cannot yet score, and the dashboard has to say so rather than invent a number. Referenced by a contract, an open order and the HDPE bag stock.
